question: Can one model call extract correct methotrexate-trial encounters with citable spans from rheumatology documentation, excluding missed visits, contact attempts, and other agents' courses? (D97)
scoring: D17: an event matches on ISO date; spans anchored by quote (D18).

spans.quote:
01/13/2026 - Rheumatology follow-up. Methotrexate started at 15 mg orally
once weekly with folic acid 1 mg daily. Joint exam: 9 tender, 6 swollen.
Morning stiffness 90 minutes. Baseline CBC, CMP and hepatic panel reviewed;
no abnormalities.

02/10/2026 - Rheumatology follow-up. Methotrexate increased to 17.5 mg
weekly. Joint exam: 8 tender, 5 swollen. Morning stiffness 75 minutes.
CBC and hepatic panel reviewed; transaminases within normal limits.

03/10/2026 - Rheumatology follow-up. Methotrexate increased to 20 mg weekly,
tolerated without nausea. Joint exam: 7 tender, 5 swollen. Morning stiffness
60 minutes. DAS28-CRP 4.9. Monitoring labs reviewed; unremarkable.

04/14/2026 - Rheumatology follow-up. Methotrexate continued at 20 mg weekly.
Joint exam: 7 tender, 4 swollen. Morning stiffness 60 minutes, unchanged.
CBC and CMP reviewed; stable.

05/12/2026 - Rheumatology follow-up. Methotrexate increased to 22.5 mg
weekly given persistent synovitis. Joint exam: 7 tender, 4 swollen.
DAS28-CRP 4.7. Hepatic panel reviewed; within normal limits.

06/09/2026 - Rheumatology follow-up. Methotrexate at maximum tolerated oral
dose of 25 mg weekly. Joint exam: 6 tender, 4 swollen. Morning stiffness
55 minutes. DAS28-CRP 4.6, inadequate improvement on methotrexate
monotherapy. CBC, CMP and hepatic panel reviewed; no abnormalities.
Discussion begun regarding addition of a biologic agent.

02/12/2026 - Monitoring visit. Methotrexate 20 mg orally once weekly,
adherent. Joint exam: 6 tender, 3 swollen. Morning stiffness 45 minutes.
CBC and hepatic panel reviewed; no abnormalities.

03/12/2026 - Monitoring visit. Methotrexate continued at 20 mg weekly.
Joint exam: 6 tender, 3 swollen. Reports fatigue the day after dosing.
CBC and CMP reviewed; stable.

06/11/2026 - Monitoring visit. Methotrexate resumed at 22.5 mg weekly after
self-reported lapse in dosing during May. Joint exam: 7 tender, 4 swollen.
Morning stiffness 70 minutes. CBC and hepatic panel reviewed; unremarkable.

07/09/2026 - Monitoring visit. Methotrexate continued at 22.5 mg weekly,
adherent since resumption. Joint exam: 6 tender, 4 swollen. DAS28-CRP 4.5.
Monitoring labs reviewed; stable.

spans.claim: Prior methotrexate trial with lack of efficacy
spans.quote: Ms. Aldana reports that she was treated with methotrexate by a rheumatologist in another state for approximately eight months, ending in early 2025.
